items.summary: IRVINE, Calif., July 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tarsus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: TARS) today announced that Aziz Mottiwala, Chief Commercial Officer, is departing the Company to pursue a new opportunity as Chief Executive Officer of a public medical device company.
